rules: Only registry.review is the current approval decision. Documents and candidate existence never promote it.
Numeric results are not visual passes. Zero source-planted pairs does not prove support.
Numeric clip/master matches alone do not bind changed travel or context metadata: different_snapshot/not_bound manifestBinding requires reconciliation.
Binding not_bound means the document omits exact master/clip identity; do not transfer its verdict to current assets.
Different clip/master evidence is historical or candidate-specific, never an unresolved defect of the current clip by itself.
Priorities/workGroups are inventory triage, not newly observed defects. Reconcile method differences before changing motion.
Public-master approval does not approve v9. All v9 skin/contact/visual gates remain separate.
Visual observations are recorded author findings, not images newly inspected for this inventory.
Product holds preserve acquisition and conversion status and require individual review; no permanent exclusion is inferred.
